assertions.name: family_a_matches_jones_at_h2
assertions.source: Family A's +3/4 h² coefficient is derived from Wedderburn dim sum on H_4; Jones polynomial's h² coefficient comes from the Markov trace of β_Bor scaled by 4. Their equality is a non-trivial theorem (Yekutieli 2015 / Markov trace ↔ Wedderburn).

assertions.name: family_a_terminates_at_h2
assertions.source: Family A linking_weight = (1/4)·Σ_{λ⊢4} dim_q V_λ = 5/2 + (3/4) h² terminates exactly at h² (Lean-proved in lambda-scale-substrate-form.lean).

assertions.name: jones_has_h4_or_higher_correction_above_unit_threshold
assertions.source: Jones polynomial V(𝓑₃, q²) is degree-3 in q²; its expansion in h necessarily has terms beyond h².  Max |c_{2k>2}| ≈ 3.03 (the h⁴ coefficient).  Pass iff |c_{h⁴}| > 1.

assertions.name: gap_localisation_clean_winner
assertions.source: Audit-internal localisation flag.  h₂-percentage of the exact-anchor gap = 91.9565%.  A clean localisation (>80% in either bucket) cleanly identifies the right refinement direction (Reading-A vs q-dilog tower).  Empirical: Reading-A (h² coefficient) accounts for ≈92% of the gap; q-dilog tower (h⁴+) accounts for ≈8%.

description: γγ̄ pair-production decomposition of β_Bor = (σ₀σ₁⁻¹)³ at each Gröbner-Shirshov filtration order (h-power).  Compares PROVED Family A linking_weight (which terminates at h²) against the Markov-trace-via-Jones-polynomial route (all orders in h) and against the CODATA-anchor target.  Localises whether the 2.89% Geom_full(𝓑₃) gap enters at h² (Reading-A hypothesis: +3/4 h² should be −G h²) or at h⁴⁺ (q-dilog tower hypothesis: Family A truncates higher-order corrections). Audit-only — no CODATA value flows into a prediction; the anchor inversion is for target reconstruction only.

gap_localisation.interpretation: Family A and Jones share the same h² coefficient (+3/4) by construction; their numerical disagreement at q₀ is entirely from h⁴+ Jones corrections Family A truncates.  If h2_percentage_of_gap >> 50%: hypothesis H₁ (Reading-A) is favored — the gap is in the h² coefficient (Family A's +3/4 should be the Reading-A value −G ≈ −0.916).  If h2_percentage_of_gap << 50%: hypothesis H₂ (q-dilog tower) is favored — the gap is in higher-order corrections Family A truncates.
